channel.title: AI Daily News
channel.description: Daily curated AI news, 10 articles max. Curated, credible, traceable.

item.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
item.description: LangChain now claims 7,000 customers of its model and platform agnostic agent management tool LangSmith.

item.title: ChatGPT’s new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
item.description: ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out on users' behalf, starting with a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers.

item.title: Nectar launches an AI agent to automate creator discovery and outreach for brands
item.description: Nectar's new AI agent automates influencer marketing, helping brands discover creators, manage outreach and partnerships, and track campaign results.

item.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
item.description: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet, a secure way for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots to complete purchases with user approval and existing card protections.

item.title: Shield helps technicians hand off legacy portal work with OpenAI
item.description: Shield uses OpenAI to help IT technicians hand off work in legacy portals. Its Forge agents navigate systems so technicians can focus on issues needing their judgment.

item.title: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
item.description: Built primarily on OpenAI models, Amplitude’s proactive product agent, Wave, identifies what to build, helps teams ship changes with coding agents, and measures the impact.

item.title: Gondola doubles revenue as its team builds more with Codex
item.description: Gondola helps creatives get credit and get hired, with Codex raising its lead engineer’s output by 50% and ChatGPT simplifying daily work.

item.title: Supporting research on AI and children’s safety
item.description: OpenAI commits $2 million to research on AI and children’s safety. The work supports shared tools to measure risks and opportunities for young people.

item.title: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
item.description: A conversation with Sam Nickless, Partner and Chief Executive Officer at Gilbert + Tobin.

item.title: ChatGPT Plus for veterans and servicemembers
item.description: More than 20,000 veterans and transitioning service members have claimed a free year of ChatGPT Plus. See how they use it to prepare for civilian careers.
